market_rationale: Narrow mega-cap-led tape: SPY up 1.27% on the week while equal-weight, small caps and 65% of the universe fell over 21 sessions. The Fed hiked to 3.75-4.00% on Sept 16 with 10y at 5.17% and CPI 3.4%/PPI 5.4%, so duration, rate-sensitive defensives and credit are under pressure; the Oct 27-28 FOMC sits inside the window. Cross-sectional dispersion is wide and the pattern is mixed: semis/Taiwan/cyber continuation coexists with broad rate-driven selloffs in bonds, utilities, small caps and financials. Most of these pullbacks look fundamentally rate-driven rather than pure overreaction, so I hold a modest number of eligible reversal candidates and otherwise lean toward SPY.
portfolio_rationale: Only biotech combines a strong prior relative trend with a sharp recent relative pullback that is not clearly explained by the rate shock, so it is the sole overreaction candidate at 56%. Small caps and financials have quality pullbacks but their weakness is consistent with the Fed hike and 5%+ yields, so they are labeled no_edge near 50%. Continuation names (semis, Taiwan, cyber, Korea) lack independent in-window catalysts and carry extreme vol and light volume, so they sit near coin-flip. Bond dislocations and utilities/solar/defense are fundamental deterioration. Net: modest biotech sleeve, remainder SPY.
